info.name: Triple F Media - Complete API Collection

request.description: Admin user login. Returns JWT token and user info.
Register new admin user (Super Admin only)
Approve creator application and create creator profile

Reject application with specific reason. rejectionType can be: content_quality, engagement_rate_low, niche_not_in_demand, followers_below_5k, fake_followers, incomplete_application, location_not_serviceable, custom
Create new campaign with creators and brief PDF
Mark campaign as completed and generate report
Send campaign brief via WhatsApp to creator
Mark creator post as live and set payment pending
Process individual creator payment via Razorpay UPI
Process multiple payments in bulk with TDS calculation
Generate PDF report for completed campaign
Submit creator application. Triggers confirmation email and WhatsApp.
